what: When the page opens, two top and bottom strips covering the screen split up and down at .9s after 1.1s, and the film (still frame) seen between the strips disappears over .4s from .5s — a movie-start style loader

options.dur: Seconds for the band to split and clear, default 0.9 — the film fades in the same ratio (from 5/9 of dur for 4/9) and ends together with the band. It takes delay + dur seconds (default 2) for the screen to open fully, then fx:done fires
options.[data-fx-part=film]: Item that appears and disappears between bands (child)
options.fx:done: When fully retracted, the element fires this event and hides
options.travel: Distance the band drops (band height %), default 100 — open-rise 150
options.pinch: Distance (px) the strips pull back first to open a gap in the center before splitting, default 0 (off) — brand 10
options.pinchAt: When the retreat starts (seconds, from the beginning), default 0 — brand 1
options.pinchScale: Horizontal stretch multiplier while receding, default 2
options.round: Corner radius (%) rounding the band’s inner edge as it exits, default 0 — brand 50 makes the upper band’s lower edge curve into a U as it leaves

use: — Default is the original length (2s)

from.where: index.html .wr-pre old approximation — the original loading splits a band with power4.out .9s after 31 cuts of words and photos. To use the original, see cut-flash-loader

shared.js loading (.or-loading — original: progress line fills in .4s power2.out and folds to the right in .5s power2.in, then at .3s the top and bottom bands split at ±150% in 1.4s (phone 1.8s) expo.inOut, minimum loading .8s)

index.html first opening (original HomeIntro — after 1s the strips retreat ±10px·2x wide in .2s power4.in, showing the film through a 20px center gap, and after 1.5s the inner edges round to 50% and exit at ±100% in .5s power4.in)
from.options: delay: 2.5; dur: 0.5; ease: power4.in; pinch: 10; pinchAt: 1; round: 50

note: Between the original bands is a black-and-white film video — a still placeholder, as in the rebuild
